content: {"praised":["Tarantino’s influence shines through the story and characters","Dark comedic tone delivers non‑stop violence with satire","Strong character performances, especially Christian Slater and Gary Oldman","Humorous moments add levity to the crime narrative","Engaging, fast‑paced action sequences keep viewers hooked"],"criticized":["Natural Born Killers feels excruciatingly boring for most of its runtime","Plot is hard to follow and confusing in places","Lacks depth and emotional resonance in key scenes","Story pacing uneven, especially in the second film","Overall tone feels too chaotic and disjointed"]}
